answer: Rotating challenge grove. Each identity must answer a fresh, context-derived puzzle keyed to its stated role and recent actions; the response is verified against a hidden seed, then discarded. Any reused or copied answer fails, since the seed changes per round. A zephyr-like random beacon drives seed rotation, so precomputation is useless. Attackers must solve each puzzle live, paying compute and latency per identity; mass sybils stall because answers cannot echo across accounts.
